note: Tennessee State Parks, on the Cumberland Plateau beside the Big South Fork; known for dark-sky viewing. Wooded sites, all with water, electric at about two thirds; most pads are short. Bathhouse and dump station; trash-can-free (bins at the campground entrance). --Claude
